1 # GUI Test Suite — `tests/gui/` 2 3 This directory contains tests for the MCP Server Dashboard GUI: both server-side 4 handlers (`api.ts`, `orchestrator-manager.ts`, etc.) and browser-side view scripts 5 (`public/views/*.js`, `public/js/orchestrator-widgets.js`). 6 7 --- 8 9 ## Browser-Side View Tests 10 11 View tests use `@vitest-environment jsdom` and load frontend JavaScript files 12 directly via `node:fs` + `node:vm` rather than a real browser. This gives 13 deterministic, fast tests without Playwright overhead while still exercising the 14 DOM rendering logic. 15 16 ### Shared Setup File — `setup-gui-globals.ts` 17 18 `mcp-server/vitest.config.ts` registers `tests/gui/setup-gui-globals.ts` as a 19 `setupFiles` entry. This file runs automatically **before every test file** and: 20 21 1. Loads `utils.js` into `globalThis` (provides `escapeHtml`, `formatDate`, 22 `showLoading`, `showError`, `statusBadge`, `breadcrumb`, `ProjectNameCache`, …). 23 2. Loads `components.js` into `globalThis` (provides the `UI` namespace — `UI.badge`, 24 `UI.banner`, `UI.emptyState`, `UI.card`, `UI.filterBar`). 25 3. Installs a `localStorage` stub on the Node `global` so that view scripts calling 26 `localStorage.getItem/setItem` inside `vm.runInThisContext` don't throw. 27 28 The setup file is guarded by `typeof document !== 'undefined'`, so it is a no-op for 29 server-side tests that run in the default Node environment. 30 31 > **`localStorage` stub limitations:** The stub implements `getItem`, `setItem`, 32 > `removeItem`, and `clear` only. It does **not** implement `key()`, `length`, or 33 > `storage` events. If a view script begins iterating `localStorage.length` or 34 > listening for `StorageEvent`, the stub must be extended (or replaced with jsdom's 35 > built-in `window.localStorage`). Server-side test files that run in the Node 36 > environment are unaffected — the stub is only installed when `document` exists. 37 38 > **`showError()` delegates to `UI.banner()`:** Since WP-2 rework, `showError()` 39 > in `utils.js` calls `UI.banner('error', message)` and therefore emits 40 > `

…

`. Tests that need to intercept `showError` should 41 > override it with a `vi.fn()` spy in their own `beforeAll` (after the setup file 42 > has loaded `utils.js`). 43 44 ### Script Loading Order — Per-Test Pattern 45 46 Each test file only needs to load its **view-specific** scripts in `beforeAll`. 47 `utils.js` and `components.js` are already loaded by the shared setup file — do not 48 re-load them. 49 50 ```typescript 51 import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; 52 import { join } from 'node:path'; 53 import vm from 'node:vm'; 54 55 const publicDir = join(__dirname, '../../gui/public'); 56 // utils.js and components.js are loaded by setup-gui-globals.ts — omit them here. 57 const myViewJs = readFileSync(join(publicDir, 'views/my-view.js'), 'utf-8'); 58 59 beforeAll(() => { 60 // Set any view-specific stubs or overrides first, then load the view script. 61 vm.runInThisContext(myViewJs); 62 }); 63 ``` 64 65 **⚠️ Do not re-load `utils.js` or `components.js`.** The setup file already loads 66 them once per test file. Duplicate `vm.runInThisContext` calls are harmless but 67 wasteful. 68 69 ### Dependency Graph 70 71 ``` 72 utils.js → defines escapeHtml, formatDate, breadcrumb, statusBadge, 73 showLoading, showError (→ UI.banner), etc. 74 components.js → defines UI (badge, banner, emptyState, card, filterBar); 75 depends on escapeHtml from utils.js 76 api-client.js → defines API; depends on nothing (uses fetch) 77 orchestrator-widgets.js → defines OrchestratorWidgets; depends on escapeHtml, UI 78 views/*.js → depend on utils.js + components.js; some also need API / OrchestratorWidgets 79 ``` 80 81 ### TypeScript Global Declarations 82 83 View scripts write to `globalThis` via IIFE assignments. TypeScript needs matching 84 `declare global` entries so the test file can reference these names without type errors: 85 86 ```typescript 87 declare global { 88 // eslint-disable-next-line no-var 89 var UI: { 90 badge: (type: string, label: string, opts?: { attrs?: Record }) => string; 91 banner: (type: string, message: string) => string; 92 emptyState: (message: string) => string; 93 }; 94 // eslint-disable-next-line no-var 95 var escapeHtml: (s: any) => string; 96 // ... declare other globals consumed by the view under test 97 } 98 ``` 99 100 ### Examples

   105	| Test file | View exercised |

   107	| `client-rendering.test.ts` | `views/work-package.js`, `views/project-detail.js` |

   111	| `project-detail-auto-update.test.ts` | `views/project-detail.js` (DOM identity + polling invariants) |
   112	| `project-detail-snapshot.test.ts` | `views/project-detail.js` (`_snapshotProjectState`) |
   113	| `project-detail-diff.test.ts` | `views/project-detail.js` (`_diffProjectState`) |
   114	| `dialogue-qa.test.ts` | `views/project-detail.js`, `views/work-package.js` |
   115	| `orchestrator-widgets.test.ts` | `js/orchestrator-widgets.js` |
   116	| `run-log.test.ts` | `views/run-log.js` |
   117	
   118	### Shared Test Helpers — Per-File vs. Shared Fixture
   119	
   120	All six `project-detail-*.test.ts` files share a single canonical fixture factory
   121	defined in `tests/gui/helpers/make-project.ts` and imported into each test file:
   122	
   123	```typescript
   124	import { makeProject } from './helpers/make-project.js';
   125	```
   126	
   127	#### `makeProject()` API
   128	
   129	```typescript
   130	export interface MakeProjectOpts {
   131	  meta?: Partial<Record<string, unknown>>;  // merged into meta object
   132	  work_packages?: unknown[];                // root-level array
   133	  synthesis_generated?: boolean;            // root-level flag
   134	  timing?: unknown;                         // root-level timing field
   135	  [key: string]: unknown;                   // additional root-level overrides
   136	}
   137	
   138	export function makeProject(opts: MakeProjectOpts = {}): ProjectFixture
   139	```
   140	
   141	The factory separates meta-level and root-level overrides explicitly — pass meta
   142	field overrides under the `meta` key, and root-level overrides at the top level:
   143	
   144	```typescript
   145	// Override a meta field:
   146	makeProject({ meta: { status: 'COMPLETE' } })
   147	
   148	// Override a root-level field:
   149	makeProject({ synthesis_generated: true })
   150	makeProject({ work_packages: [wp1, wp2] })
   151	
   152	// Both at once:
   153	makeProject({ meta: { status: 'IN_PROGRESS' }, work_packages: [wp] })
   154	```
   155	
   156	Default meta fields: `status: 'IN_PROGRESS'`, `title: 'Test Project'`,
   157	`plan_path: '/some/path'`, `date_created`, `last_updated`.
   158	Default root fields: `work_packages: []`, `project_comments: []`,
   159	`synthesis_generated: false`, `timing: null`, `server_version: null`,
   160	`ledger_version: null`.
   161	
   162	> **Type-safety note:** The `[key: string]: unknown` index signature is a deliberate
   163	> tradeoff for test-fixture ergonomics. TypeScript will **not** error on unknown root
   164	> keys (e.g. `makeProject({ statues: 'COMPLETE' })` silently passes). This is
   165	> acceptable for fixtures; use the explicit named keys (`meta`, `work_packages`, etc.)
   166	> to avoid silent typos.
   167	
   168	---
   169	
   170	## Server-Side Tests
   171	
   172	Server-side tests (e.g., `api.test.ts`, `config.test.ts`, `auto-archive.test.ts`) run
   173	in the default Node environment and do not need to load any frontend scripts. They
   174	test TypeScript handlers directly by importing from `../../gui/api.ts` and related
   175	modules.
   176	
   177	---
   178	
   179	## Running the Suite
   180	
   181	```bash
   182	# From mcp-server/
   183	npx vitest run tests/gui/
   184	
   185	# With coverage
   186	npx vitest run tests/gui/ --coverage
   187	```
